images.qa: A padlock through the hasp of an industrial lever: nothing moves without authorization. 4:5 approved first roll. The 16:9 took one re-roll — the first put red on the hasp bracket as well as the padlock, two separate red objects. Naming every part that must not be red ('the hasp, the bracket, the lever, the mounting plate, the rivets and the panel are all cream-grey or navy, never red, never partly red, never red-trimmed') fixed it; 'exactly one red element' alone did not, because the generator reads adjacent hardware as one object.
